name: SDF Light Shaping
aliases: SDF Light Shaping — Raymarched Light Shaping
definition: Uses Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) to determine if a raymarching sample point is inside a light shape (e.g., cylinder, cone), allowing light to be accumulated only within the defined volume.
summary: SDF Light Shaping defines volumetric light geometry using Signed Distance Functions during raymarching, decoupling light shape from ray direction to enable complex, non-conical volumes like cylinders.
